say:1:1830126001:0.text: Good taste! These flowers are imported straight from the Lightbearer Empire! They make the perfect death anniversary gift!
say:1:1830126001:0.source_cn: 客人真是慧眼识珠啊！这些可都是从耀光帝国进口的花，最适...
say:1:1830126001:0.male: Good taste! These flowers are imported straight from the Lightbearer Empire! They make the perfect death anniversary gift!
say:1:1830126001:0.female: Good taste! These flowers are imported straight from the Lightbearer Empire! They make the perfect death anniversary gift!

say:2:1830126002:1.text: These flowers are a favorite among stowaways! You know, they love buying them to honor their departed family and friends.
say:2:1830126002:1.source_cn: 那些偷渡者都喜欢给自己死去的亲朋好友送上一束！
say:2:1830126002:1.male: These flowers are a favorite among stowaways! You know, they love buying them to honor their departed family and friends.
say:2:1830126002:1.female: These flowers are a favorite among stowaways! You know, they love buying them to honor their departed family and friends.

say:7:1830126006:0.text: Hey, rare things don't come cheap! Besides, these flowers remind Lightbearer folks of home. You can't put a price on sentimental value!
say:7:1830126006:0.source_cn: 物以稀为贵嘛。再说了，生前来自耀光帝国的亡灵有几个不想...

say:8:1830126007:0.text: ... I think you've got a point. Alright, I'll get one.
say:8:1830126007:0.source_cn: ……说得也有道理。好吧，给我来一朵。

say:9:1830126008:0.text: Just one? Isn't that a little... skimpy for a gift?
say:9:1830126008:0.source_cn: 只要一朵吗？这送人是不是有点……

say:10:1830126009:1.text: It's for myself—a reminder to work on my sales pitch and be as smooth as you.
say:10:1830126009:1.source_cn: 我是送我自己。提醒我做生意的时候学学你的口舌。
